items.prompt:
Writing should match its task, purpose, and:
A) audience
B) page color
C) font size

steps: Fit the reader. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Writing that flows logically and connects ideas is:
A) coherent
B) random
C) off-topic

A formal essay should use a:
A) formal tone
B) slangy tone
C) joking tone

Which greeting best fits a FORMAL letter to a school principal?
A) 'Dear Principal Reyes,'
B) 'Hey!'
C) 'Yo,'

What makes a paragraph coherent?
A) sentences connect logically and stay on one idea
B) random unrelated facts
C) no transitions at all
items.answer: A) sentences connect logically and stay on one idea

solution.answer: A) sentences connect logically and stay on one idea

items.prompt:
If your audience is young children, your writing should be:
A) simple and clear
B) full of technical jargon
C) very formal and complex

steps: Match the audience. Key is A.

items.prompt:
A student writes a science report but keeps slipping in jokes and slang. The main problem is that the STYLE does not match the:
A) task and audience
B) page count
C) spelling

Which revision most improves COHERENCE?
A) adding transitions so each idea leads to the next
B) adding unrelated facts
C) removing all paragraph breaks
items.answer: A) adding transitions so each idea leads to the next

steps: Transitions aid flow. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) adding transitions so each idea leads to the next
